name: Churn risk
prompt: Churn risk: MRR at risk by industry, churned accounts by region and plan, and the list of churned accounts.

binding.sql: SELECT industry AS industry, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN churned THEN mrr ELSE 0 END),0) AS at_risk_mrr FROM churn_risk GROUP BY industry ORDER BY at_risk_mrr DESC

copy.title: MRR lost to churn by industry
copy.caption: Fintech and Retail account for the most churned MRR, though every industry lost 17 accounts.

binding.sql: SELECT region AS region, SUM(CASE WHEN churned THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS churned FROM churn_risk GROUP BY region ORDER BY churned DESC

copy.title: Churned accounts by region
copy.caption: Churn is remarkably even — each region lost 21 or 22 accounts.

binding.sql: SELECT plan AS plan, SUM(CASE WHEN churned THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS churned FROM churn_risk GROUP BY plan ORDER BY churned DESC

copy.title: Churned accounts by plan
copy.caption: No single plan is a churn outlier — losses track plan size.

binding.sql: SELECT industry AS industry, SUM(CASE WHEN churned THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS churned FROM churn_risk GROUP BY industry ORDER BY churned DESC

copy.title: Churn share by industry
copy.caption: The 85 churned accounts are evenly distributed across industries.

binding.sql: SELECT account AS account, industry AS industry, region AS region, plan AS plan, ROUND(mrr,0) AS mrr, lifetime_days AS lifetime_days FROM churn_risk WHERE churned ORDER BY mrr DESC LIMIT 50

copy.title: Churned accounts
copy.caption: Every churned account, ranked by the monthly revenue it took with it.
